title: Cross-Desk Reference — Relief for Other Commitments with the Chain, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

# Cross-Desk Reference — Relief for Other Commitments with the Chain, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

Where the customer taking an arrangement on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan also has a commission running under the Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions, the finance desk allows a relief against the reduced payment. The desk reads the stage the commission stands at and whether a balance is still to pay on it.

| The customer's design studio commission | The relief allowed |
|---|---|
| Stands in production, **and** a balance is still to pay on it | This desk's larger commitment relief of **15.00 USD** |
| Stands at the approval of its design, **and** a balance is still to pay on it | This desk's commitment relief of **8.00 USD** |
| Any other case, including a customer with no commission | No relief is allowed for other commitments |

Both bands need a balance still to pay: a commission in production already paid in full falls in the third row, as does a commission at any other stage — in consultation, waiting on its deposit, held up, ready to hand over, delivered or cancelled.

## What is read from the commission

The stage the commission stands at and the balance still to pay on it come from the customer's commission record under the Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions. No other rule of that programme bears on the relief.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A commission in production with 2,400.00 USD still to pay: 15.00 USD.
- A commission at the approval of its design with 900.00 USD still to pay: 8.00 USD.
- A commission in production with nothing still to pay: no relief is allowed.
